title: Add SparkplugB dissector
description:
Add a dissector for SparkplugB as a heuristic subdissector of MQTT
and which calls protobuf to dissect the messages payload.

notes.body:
I have tested the new protobuf\sparkplug_b.proto file is included in an NSIS build, I think I've done the correct things for a WiX build but haven't tested it and I can't find what, if anything, I need to adjust for dpkg\rpm and macOS.

I'd appreciate it if anyone using those platforms could test.

I've attached a capture file to test with [SampleSparkPlug_Wireshark_Trace.pcapng](/uploads/4b9a7a4d1f9b032327092e20fd2d8d4e/SampleSparkPlug_Wireshark_Trace.pcapng).

Hello Graham,

Compiling on macOS failed with the following error:

```
/projects/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-sparkplug.c:56:36: error: expression result unused [-Werror,-Wunused-value]
    proto_item *ti, *namespace_ti; *ti;
                                   ^~~
/projects/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-sparkplug.c:56:37: error: variable 'ti' is uninitialized when used here [-Werror,-Wuninitialized]
    proto_item *ti, *namespace_ti; *ti;
                                    ^~
/projects/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-sparkplug.c:56:19: note: initialize the variable 'ti' to silence this warning
    proto_item *ti, *namespace_ti; *ti;
                  ^
                   = NULL
```

Deleting the trailing `*ti;` the compile completed.

Running tshark with your sample produced the following:

```
myMacVm2:ninja-build jyoung$ ./run/tshark -r ~/Traces/SampleSparkPlug_Wireshark_Trace.pcapng -C SampleSparkPlug 
    1   0.000000  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 SparkplugB 149 SparkplugB, DDATA (PROTOBUF) com.cirruslink.sparkplug.protobuf.Payload
    2   0.042393 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  TCP 60 1883 → 60184 [ACK] Seq=1 Ack=96 Win=501 Len=0
    3   0.108188  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 MQTT 56 Ping Request
    4   0.150225 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  TCP 60 1883 → 60184 [ACK] Seq=1 Ack=98 Win=501 Len=0
    5   0.150431 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  MQTT 60 Ping Response
    6   0.198674  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 TCP 54 60184 → 1883 [ACK] Seq=98 Ack=3 Win=512 Len=0
    7  78.799930  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 SparkplugB 149 SparkplugB, DDATA (PROTOBUF) com.cirruslink.sparkplug.protobuf.Payload
    8  78.882970 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  TCP 60 1883 → 60184 [ACK] Seq=3 Ack=193 Win=501 Len=0
    9  78.905888  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 MQTT 56 Ping Request
   10  78.948100 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  TCP 60 1883 → 60184 [ACK] Seq=3 Ack=195 Win=501 Len=0
   11  78.948102 155.138.239.5 → 10.158.6.73  MQTT 60 Ping Response
   12  78.998197  10.158.6.73 → 155.138.239.5 TCP 54 60184 → 1883 [ACK] Seq=195 Ack=5 Win=512 Len=0
myMacVm2:ninja-build jyoung$ 
```

Oops, obvious last minute typo, will be fixed.

@jim.young was that test from an installed version or running from the build directory (I think it is)?  I'm interested in results from an installed copy to test the installer is correctly built.  The output you show is the expected data.
